description: Records that a person asked not to be emailed, on this Precleared key's opt-out list, so every agent and tool using the key gets blocked for that address from contact_check. Use it as soon as someone replies stop, unsubscribes, bounces or complains. Give email or domain; set remove to true only when the person asks to be emailed again. Needs a Precleared key (a free one is fine). Never charged. The address is kept only as a hash and a masked copy.

domain.description: A whole domain, such as acme.co.uk.

remove.description: True to take the entry off the list.

name: suppress_contact
title: Add to or remove from the opt-out list
